high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from "The Times of India" website. The headline and some text are partially visible at the top, indicating that it is discussing an event involving Greta Thunberg and her journey on a humanitarian vessel. In the center of the image, there is a tweet from the official Twitter account of the Israel Foreign Ministry (@IsraelMFA). The tweet reads: "Greta Thunberg just departed Israel on a flight to Sweden (via France)." The tweet includes two photographs showing Greta Thunberg seated on an airplane.
